verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Rewards a sharply particularized scene/actor/action in the joke content itself, independent of typography, which is a genuine craft measure.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Pure count of tag/handle/keyword furniture explicitly divorced from whether the tagging is apt, funny, or good; keyword-stuffing behavior has no plausible link to genuinely better writing.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Pure estimate of capitalization/emphatic-punctuation share, explicitly not judging whether the emphasis is earned or suits the joke; a typing-style habit, not a skill marker.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether a comic list structure culminates in an effective pattern-breaking twist, a genuine joke-construction feature.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Judges whether the complete comic premise and payoff are present in the text alone, a genuine completeness-of-craft measure.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Flags mere doubled-space typographic artifacts with explicit indifference to readability; a copy-paste/typing artifact with no link to joke quality.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Explicitly strips tags and typography and judges only the craft of the line's spoken rhythm, cadence, and sound.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Checks whether the joke's mechanism is a concrete behavior, contradiction, or institution rather than bare topic-naming, i.e. genuine engagement with the content.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Scores whether the wording enacts a literal self-reversal exposing a comic contradiction, a core joke technique.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Judges whether a specific concrete particular, rather than a generic label, is doing the comic work.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Measures how quickly the payoff resolves for the reader, an intrinsic craft/design property of how the joke is built.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether the wording exploits the format constraint as a natural complete phrase rather than reading as padded or truncated, a craft judgment.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Scores whether the ending delivers a decisive comic payoff versus stopping at setup, core punchline craft.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Flags presence of a bare shortened URL pointing at unseen content, explicitly not inferring whether the missing payload is funny; a platform/production artifact.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Counts presence of URLs, attachment cues, or platform artifacts, explicitly never judging whether they improve the entry.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Compares tag casing to the canonical form as a pure fidelity/convention-following check, not a quality judgment, though matching the canonical form plausibly also marks a practiced entrant familiar with the contest who writes better jokes too.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Counts trailing non-sentence furniture (tags, handles, parenthetical byline) appended after the joke, explicitly not a writing-quality judgment, though a habitual byline could mark a more invested repeat entrant who also writes better material.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Scores whether the wording sets up one reading and pivots to another, classic comic misdirection craft.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Scores whether two unlike concepts collide into an immediately intelligible joke, a core comic-technique measure.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Purely checks whether '@midnight' literally opens the text, an extent/positional-formatting measure explicitly not a quality judgment, and more likely a submission-mechanic (reply-thread) artifact than a skill marker.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Scores whether the tweet evokes a vivid, instantly picturable scene, a content/craft property.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Counts off-prompt material such as promo tags, self-branding, and show flattery, explicitly not judging whether such self-promotion is tacky; this padding is more plausibly a distraction than a marker of better writing.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Judges whether a recognizable title is reworked into a fresh, coherent comic premise, a transformation-craft measure.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Scores how much original idea a mashup/pun substitution adds beyond bare source-recognition, genuine craft depth.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Maps raw word count to a 0-10 extent scale, explicitly not judging whether the length is effective, though more words can also reflect a more fully realized setup-and-payoff that is genuinely better crafted.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Estimates overall character length plus tag/handle count as a bulk/furniture extent that by its own description scores a bloated item and a well-used long item identically, so the same bulk can stem from either nuisance padding or genuinely fuller craft.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Scores whether rhythm, repetition, or sound make the line punchy when read aloud, a comic-delivery craft measure.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Scores how much a borrowed stock phrase is recontextualized versus quoted verbatim, a transformation-craft measure.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Estimates the extent of capitalized or shouted typography, explicitly not judging whether it suits the joke, a typographic habit rather than a craft measure.
